Things about me: Hello, this is Mishenanigan from House Shenanigans. I am a student at the University of British Columbia. I was born in a small town in Southernwest Chinese coast. My undergraduate degree was done in the department of Mathmathics from the the same institution. From the MDS program I am hoping to learn more about data science and its applications in the real world.
Things I do I mean I am writing a novel and I am hoping to one day publish it but I probably have a long way to go from there.
